meta_description: Greenery Garden Services in Birmingham. Expert garden maintenance, landscaping and design. Free quotes on all projects. Call 07763 221697 today.
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to complete landscape redesigns, Greenery Garden Services brings your outdoor space back to life.
services_subhead: Whether you need a tidy-up, a full redesign, or regular upkeep, we handle every aspect of garden care.

services.title: Garden Maintenance & Lawn Care
services.desc: Regular grass cutting, edge trimming, weeding and seasonal tidying. Keep your lawn healthy and your borders weed-free all year round.

services.title: Hedge Trimming & Pruning
services.desc: Expert pruning of shrubs, hedges and trees to shape, health and safety standards. We'll remove overgrown growth and keep everything proportioned.

services.title: Garden Design & Landscaping
services.desc: From concept to completion. We create bespoke garden designs with new planting, patios, decking and hardscaping to suit your style and budget.

services.title: Turfing & Seeding
services.desc: Bare patches and threadbare lawns? We lay quality turf or overseed problem areas to get your grass thick and green within weeks.

services.title: Garden Clearance & Waste Removal
services.desc: Clear overgrown, neglected gardens safely and responsibly. We haul away all waste and leave your space ready for a fresh start.

services.title: Planting & Seasonal Displays
services.desc: Spring bulbs, summer bedding, autumn plantings and winter interest. We choose plants suited to your soil and light, and install them properly.

about_pullquote: I started this to prove that proper gardening care shouldn't cost the earth.
about_para_1: Greenery Garden Services was founded in 2009 by Mark Stevens, a lifelong gardener frustrated by cowboys charging inflated prices for shoddy work. Over 15 years, we've built a reputation across Birmingham for honest pricing, expert plant knowledge, and gardens that actually thrive. We treat every border and lawn like it's our own.
about_para_2: Our repeat customer rate sits at over 70% — that's because we listen to what you want, deliver on time, and turn up when we say we will. No jargon, no hidden charges. Just a friendly team who know how to coax the best from your soil.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a nightmare garden full of weeds and dead patches. Mark and the team came in, cleared the lot, laid new turf and planted some borders. Completely transformed it. Really friendly bunch, turned up on time, and the price was spot on. Couldn't be happier.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: We've had them maintain our garden for three years now. They come every fortnight, keep everything pristine, and genuinely care about the plants. Never had to chase them or worry about quality. Best decision we made.
reviews.author: Jennifer T.

reviews.text: Brilliant from start to finish. Free quote, clear plan, and they delivered exactly what they said. My hedge looks perfect now and they even tidied up after themselves. Proper job. Will be booking them again.
reviews.author: Michael H.
